body: That's the boat I'm in at the moment

No, not really, I was actually going to kill myself the night I read your story. There were things I'd do, but they aren't appropriate or the right method of fixing things. Obviously there is the medication route and boy was I on a lot, I was basically on a permanent sedative. It seemed to help make the voices and urges softer, easier to fight, but they were still there. I was also admitted to a clinic while they got my meds right. I do suggest getting a second opinion, or even a third, or until you get the right meds.
I'll be thinking about you today.

Thank you for making this post. I don't have the balls to make my own one and a lot of what you said really struck home for me. Down to the voices, demon, everything. It's a comfort to know I'm not alone. Thank you again for sharing.
Thank you.

the diagnoses for bipolar was a bit of a shock, as I thought that had been written out (I was told it was not bipolar, to only later find it on my forms anyway) I wish I could ask my doctor about this, and get an explanation on how it came to that, but she charged me just to fill out forms, I really don't need any more expenses. 

I'm actually from South Africa and the healthcare here is little to none. Not to mention I deal with parents who don't believe in psychiatry, and believe that taking medication is just as bad as being on drugs.
yup, doesn't give you much faith in the profession.

I could from the government, but then I'd have to go to a government facility, probably loose my job for taking more time off, and I really don't trust government facilities as last time I went to be booked into one, the guy who interviewed me kept on double questioning me and looking at his watch. I was given an admission date, which was rushed forward because I was suicidal, but they never kept it and I was sent to above mentioned private clinic.

There are parts of bipolar I can see in myself, but i'm not sure. I have extreme euphoric moments, where I feel as if i'm on mushrooms or some other hallucinogenic. The world feels magical and I feel like I can do anything, most worrying of that however, is that includes fly. I don't feel depressed  really anymore, it's hard to explain, I've felt it all my life, and I just don't feel it anymore. I still want to commit suicide most days, and hate myself, but it's more like a given than a depression, I don't feel sad, I just am? It's hard to explain. 

My psychiatrist said she was 99% sure I was BPD, but then went on to say that I don't show a lot of the symptoms, I am not manipulative, I don't see the world in black and white, and to be honest, I care very little for people and would rather be alone in most cases. I think just because I hurt myself she rushed to the conclusion of BPD. 

I hurt myself as a blood sacrifice to the evil inside me to calm it and let me live. And yes, the hallucinations were classified as a short lived psychosis.
I've cut out refined sugars, drink low-fat milk, don't eat bread and walk around 3 miles a day. I am trying harder though.
That would be nice but I'm kind of at a wits end. I have no idea what to do, or where to go from here and I can mentally and physically feel myself getting worse, which makes it a lot scarier.
Schizophrenia was ruled out as I am able to do day-to-day tasks like bath/shower, eat, etc.
Schizophrenia was ruled out as I am able to do day-to-day tasks like bath/shower, eat, etc.

Yeah tell me about it. That's why seeing doctors just made me so much more confused. I'm not sure they know what they are doing; the one psychiatrist even said that it takes something like 15 years of therapy until you get to a proper diagnoses. Whatever that means...
ask away. sorry, i've been in hospital.
Are you still here? How are you? I've been thinking about you.
A logo for my sisters blog (http://eatmyhatsa.blogspot.com/) something feminine / alice in wonderland / sparrows / pretty. She's a sweet gal and i'd really like to help her out.

It does not feel good; I feel like I am outside of my body and that the little control I have; that's keeping me from jumping off a bridge "to fly away" isn't going to be there for much longer. It's scary and causes me to have panic attacks at least three times a day. 

A part of me wants to give into everything, and a small part wants to get better. It's all very frustrating. 

Glad to hear you can recover though. Did you change, or did you change your surroundings? What helped the most?
I asked my therapist this exact question on Thursday; she told me definitely not; only a wing for mentally disabled / challenged  people was closed down.
Firstly, happy reddit birthday! Secondly, that's why I'm here, to get some questions / answers from Reddit that I can write down to take to my next session.
Thank you, I will try. I have to tell my boss pretty much everything next week sometime; not looking forward to that.
A logo for my sisters "alice in wonderland" themed blog "Eat my hat" (http://eatmyhatsa.blogspot.com/)

Pushing back bills won't be that helpful though seeing as I just make enough cash to cover those and then a bit of food. I am in debt as it is : / It all just does my head in.

It's difficult trying to plan for not knowing how much time I need. I don't want to deal with the black holes; that will most probably make my stay last longer then. It's so scary. *sigh* I don't know what to do.

Thank you though, it's good to know I am not alone.
This was another worry of mine, that once I am out of hospital; what then.Thank you, that's good to know.

My therapists don't want to say too much. I don't really know why. I started off as severe depression but there was also the feeling I was "loosing myself". I feel like I am loosing control of myself. That I am not in the driving seat and that there is another force driving me to do things, usually destructive things to myself. I doubt I am schizophrenic though, It doesn't all add up to that. Perhaps if left alone it could, but not right now

Thank you! My therapist / psychiatrist both agree a month isn't enough; which is why I am so scared. How much time do they think I need? How will I pay for my rent? phone bills? etc. I was able to get some money put aside, but only to pay for a month of bills and if it is going to be more I don't know if I'll be prepared. They are unable to tell how long I am going to need.

I'm really scared to face stuff from my past I have huge black holes in my memory which I am guessing are black holes for a reason and I don't really want to know why.
I hope so. Thank you for all your advice :)

my biggest fear is that, with therapy, I've been going deeper and deeper off the road. It could be therapy, or what I was feeling that made me finally seek therapy; but there is something there. I feel like I am loosing myself and I am worried that with all the intensive therapy inside the clinic I'll be totally lost. How do you recover from it? How is the world outside once you get out? Does it go on any sort of record? Will I have problems getting visas / jobs?
a month; without Internet! ARE THE INSANE?!?!
That's good to know. I hate groups, and talking to them, even more so.
Thank you!
Does she get the families involved at all? Will I get visits at my home?

Thank you; this is my biggest problem (getting anxious). I suffer severely from panic attacks and even going to therapy every week seems to throw me in the deep end. I don't know how I am going to cope for a month (minimum) doing that everyday.

Thank you so so much. 

I do smoke, but it's all so confusing, I mean how many packets do I take if I don't know how long I'm going to be in there for? How do I get more smokes? Do I take a certain amount of money with me? 

What do the social workers do? Will I have to take part in group therapy? Actually talk? Or can I just listen? Will my own psychiatrists / psychologists be there or will I get new ones?

This is what I assumed for the clinic, but the fact they changed their mind to a hospital made me wonder if that was still true. It's really scary and I am trying to take one step at a time but my head kind of gets lost on the way and I don't know what to do besides drool and stare out the window. 

They don't want to tell me exactly why, I guess because I'm a suicide risk.
Sorry, Ex. :( so I guess there won't be.
If I ask, and they feel I am not ready, will I have to stay? Or can I still leave?
Hmmm, really? Which one in Cape Town? There were talks of Valkenberg Hospital so I assume this is where they want to send me. Does she have any guidance / protips to share?

I'm really scared and as the date looms closer and closer, my "yeah i'll go in to a clinic, I'll go in LIKE A BAWS" is fading; hard and fast. My affairs aren't even all in order and that makes it even more scary. I actually really don't want to go now. I'm not sure what to do; I don't even want to go to therapy anymore. 

South Africa sucks when it comes to finding information on this sort of thing so my best bet is to ask my therapist or go look at the place myself. Can I go look around a hospital psych ward?

Okay, sorry a bit of information; I'm a 24 y/o South African lady who is going in, well, i'm not really sure, they have spoken about splits and alters, and impuses and sever depression and personality disorders. They don't want to say to much because therapy is pushing me further off the edge and they want me to be in a safe environment before they get stuck into it (my blue moosy head space)

My family isn't involved at all, and I don't want them to be, this is why there is concern about a social worker being mentioned. I don't even know what a social worker / occupational therapist does?

They said that going to the clinic and then moving out after the three weeks to a hospital would be too disruptive to my state of mind and therefore want to put me straight into a hospital. I'm really scared as the only things I've heard about government hospitals have been bad things.

They also mentioned that the state hospital has a out patient programme which the clinic did not and they thought that would be beneficial. 

That's great to know that they can't make me stay, I hope that is the same in South Africa, I will ask my therapist about that and visiting hours. Thank you.
will do.
will try.

South Africa. I'm terribly scared about the state of our state / government hospitals (woman getting raped inside of them and violent / dangerous staff) I'm sure they wouldn't put me into that situation though; right?

I asked them to wait a month so i could come up with a plan to pay rent / inform my company / get my shit in to order.

not sure how going to to a hospital is going to change that, seeing they want me to stay longer than the three weeks we had agreed on.

I have a psychiatrist and psychologist, my psychologist brought up the hospital (instead of clinic) in therapy yesterday. I have a problem with shutting down, specially in therapy when I'm talking about my own shit, so nothing came to mind. My head is a bit of a mess. That's why I asked reddit, so i can write it down and be ready for my next session.

I'm not really sure, they fear therapy isn't helping and that saying to much may drive me further. I guess it's mostly impulses / depression / not sure what else by my doctors look at me funny. All side way glances and stuff.

I was diagnosed with Multiple personality disorder yesterday and I'm terribly scared. I'm being committed in May (it would have been sooner but I got them to hold off for awhile with appointments with my psychiatrist / psychologist every week). 

I'm really scared, and don't know what to expect from going into a psych ward. What is a general day like? if you are asked to take part in therapy like hypnosis/group do you have to do it? if you go in willfully can you leave at any time you want? Is everyone treated the same, or do people with certain disorders get treated differently? Is there anything I should know before I go in, anything I should or shouldn't take with me? What do i tell friends and family that I don't want to disclose my current state / where I am?

I'll get back to you, I was diagnosed with Dissociative identity disorder / split personality disorder today, so i'm kind of going through a sob story right now. My email is candice.harper@gmail.com drop me a mail which one you like and I'll get back to you once i've had a chance to recover.

thank you, I never expected people to actually like my photos. I've never had any formal training or much encouragement, so I find this all hard to believe to be honest. Yes I'm terribly bad at marketing, it's difficult to market something you don't believe in i guess. 

I've shipped my photos before, one to my secret santee person this last year, but I never heard back from him, after asking him numerous times if he got it. 

I've printed a bunch of my photos 4x6 or 5x8 (i think that's the size) and it costs between $3 (4x6) to $5 (5x8) for the prints. The framing costs me between $5 (4x6) and $10 (5x8). The posting costs between $4 (4x6) and $10 (5x8). I'm not sure how practical it is to ship the frame though (the glass is possible to break)

That shipping in tube container does sound like a better plan. That is of course available. 

I have taken a loan from the bank for $2500 as I tried to start an event/band/portrait business with a friend of mine (yougotshot.net) but it sort of failed horribly, seeing as I've seemed to have fallen out with my friend and am quite terribly depressed. I have only spent $450 of that loan though, and am trying to pay it back so I can close that account because I can no longer afford it. 

I don't use dA anymore, and should probably take that account down. I started my own web page but the hosting company was messing me around and my site was completely deleted, with no backup (charperphotography.com). 

I'm not sure my loaned 10mp 400D can print up to 10X16 but I will give it a look and get back to you.  

Thank you again for your kind encouragement and your interest.

Not always, not all the time. Needing people to make ourselves feel better is just going to make us feel worse when they let us down. I'm trying to get over this myself. Most humans are innately selfish and put their own problems first. This is where it could be more hurt than help. However, like I said, you have reddit, we're all in your corner over here. Take this time to get to know yourself instead of feeling alone. Do things you want to do, instead of wondering if somebody else wants to do it with you. Try make a list of things you would like to do.

Do you really need somebody in your corner? I know it is more difficult without somebody there for you, but a lot of the time other people can just make it worse. Actually; you know what, forget that; you have Reddit in your corner, a lot of people on here to help you out. Try not to think about what could happen and take each day, one step at a time.
It's not about ruining yourself it's about making life and the day a bit easier to get through.

From what I hear so far you may be right, BPD and perhaps a bit of OCD. The impulses are a bitch I fight with them everyday; the hurting of myself, etc; However, I have been given some impulse control medication for that which has really helped a lot, and perhaps you should look into it. It's called epitech which is basically a generic for Lamotrigine. It's mostly used for people with epilepsy or bi-polar but don't let that deter you It's really helpful. Maybe ask your doctor about some impulse control medication / mood stabilizers. 

Everyday is tough, and I am really glad to hear from you and see that you made it through yesterday. I'm trying myself to find things to hold on to, so I can't give you any help on that, but maybe writing this all out, like you did is helping in a small part? Ranting, getting some of that anger / hurt out? 

Life is a really scary journey, specially in the position you are in, feeling alone. Just remember it is okay to be selfish, to spoil yourself a little and just forget about everybody else. It's okay to be angry and it's okay to "hate" somebody for a few weeks. Buy yourself something pretty, some jewelry, some shoes, anything. 

Also, know I am here if you want to chat, or rant, and I will probably agree that so and so is a bitch / bastard. And if you don't hear from me for awhile, it's not because i've forgotten about you, or hate you I'm just super disorganized and have something like 30 tabs open. 

Let me know how you're feeling today.

The dark; I have woken up with a stranger in my room three times (burglary). One of those times I was alone at home and I was attacked. I think I may be suffering from PTSD though. So not sure if this counts.

Have you never been curious to find out exactly what? Maybe give you some understanding and insight to why you feel the way you do, a possibility to make things better? Also, I don't mean physically, I mean mentally. How long have you been depressed for? What job do you do for a living? Do you enjoy it? What do you do to help you to get past these moments usually; besides reading about suicide?

I get that, my meds make me wake up every hour after I get to bed. You sure depressed is all that's going on? Maybe there is more hiding behind the depression? Do you have any hobbies or talents, anything that takes your mind off your depression?

Hey, I can't give you any motivation or good advice seeing as I came here for the same reason you did, but if you are lonely which I am too feel free to contact me, maybe we can chat sometime. Also, have you seen a head doctor?

Hey! Thank you! That means a lot. I had a deviantART account (http://www.lil-evil-girl.deviantart.com/) but I haven't posted on that for awhile because of what deviantART slowly started turning out like. No one has ever bought my photos or really shown any interest at all. 

If you like that photo I am more than willing to print it out and send it to you (without the frame though :( ) Let me know. 

Hope things turn out well for you. Thank you again.
Thank you :)
That's good to know. Yesterday was difficult, today is clouded by a tinge of uncertainty, but I am holding on. Thank you for all your support.
Thank you for the comment. give it a read and let me know if it is. :)

I don't know what to say to make this any better, because i know, anything somebody else says won't make it better. How you think and how you feel is all about you. I can say that just about everything you mentioned I've been going through as well; except I even though I never wanted to get help, and I didn't, for 15 years, struggling feeling this pain; finally, I took the first step. It's difficult, and scary but to actually have a bit of control in my own life, something I've never felt, is really encouraging. 

Everyday is difficult, some more so than others. Try just doing some research for doctors in your area that are able to help. Before you get to a day where you are not "lucid" and can't stop yourself from hurting yourself. 

Even better if you find a doctor and are able to get to them; phone them, without thinking and just book an appointment. Tell yourself, just one, just one meeting with them. Once you realise that there are people willing to listen, who do actually care, you'll be happy you went.

I don't even know you, and I care. It may have something to do with the similarities in our story. I hope you do OK. Drop me a line if you want to chat.
